# Copilot Project Entry

Before each task, read the shared project rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [README.md](../README.md), and the continuity documents [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md](../docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md), and [docs/AI_HANDOFF.md](../docs/AI_HANDOFF.md). Inspect `git status` and relevant local changes before editing.

Follow those files as the source of truth for AppointmentPro scope, approvals, security, Flutter validation, the no-source-comments rule, and AI handoffs. Explain progress briefly in Romanized Gujarati. Do not assume other agents read Copilot instructions or that their state synchronizes automatically.
